requirements: Per-exercise weight input: app setting, kg, or lb. Logged rows, totals, and graphs use the app unit.
Any number of named or unnamed factors per exercise; default names are Multiplier X. Enabled factors multiply together.
Input converts to canonical kg and the combined factor is captured per set. Editing a set preserves that factor.
Unit and multiplier controls available while creating an exercise, saved atomically with other exercise settings.
Routine presets and weight increments use the exercise input unit.
Older databases and backups remain readable with app-unit defaults.
